props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Iconify name for checked checkbox items. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.check`.

props.name: content
props.description:
Positioning settings — `side`, `align`, `sideOffset` control where the menu
docks relative to its trigger.

props.name: descriptionKey
props.description: Key on each item used as the rendered description.

props.name: items
props.description: Flat list, OR a nested array where each inner array becomes a group separated by a `<DropdownMenuSeparator>`.

props.name: labelKey
props.description: Key on each item used as the rendered label.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the loading spinner. Defaults to `appConfig.ui.icons.loading`.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Modality. When `true`, taps outside the menu are blocked from reaching
the underlying app.

slots.name: default
slots.description:
Trigger content. `DropdownMenuTrigger` toggles open state on tap; do NOT
also bind a `@tap` handler that sets the open state.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Custom rendering for every item (replaces all per-section defaults).

slots.name: item-leading
slots.description: Custom rendering for every item's leading slot.

slots.name: item-label
slots.description: Custom rendering for every item's label.

slots.name: item-description
slots.description: Custom rendering for every item's description.

slots.name: item-trailing
slots.description: Custom rendering for every item's trailing slot.
